{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Drop refunded orders — they are not conversions
# Only 'completed' orders count as conversions
df_clean = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:")
print(df_clean['channel'].value_counts())

# Check the customer_segment distribution by channel
print("\nCustomer segment by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract the rates
df_clean['channel'].value_counts()

# Calculate the difference: email minus paid_search
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print(f"\nConversion rate (email): {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")

# Output for submission
conversion_rates, difference"}
